newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Tunisian president to visit Argentina next week.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian president to visit Argentina next week.

text.p: Tunisian President Zine el Abidine Ben Ali will make an official visit to Argentina between March 24-26, the foreign ministry said on Friday.

"This is the first official visit by the president of an Arab country to Argentina since President Carlos Menem took office in 1989, and the first time the president of Tunisia visits our country," the ministry said in a statement.
During his stay Ben Ali will sign bilateral agreements on animal and vegetable sanitary regulations, the environment, food and agriculture.
The two governments will also endorse an economic, scientific and technical cooperation programme for agricultural activities in 1997-1999, and a cultural and educational programme for 1998-2000.
Bilateral trade between Argentina and Tunisia, based on the sale of fertilisers and clothes, was less than $100 million in 1996.
